errors.text: The proposed Cr-alloying intervention does not reconstruct the target SPS temperature intervention or its 800–1000 °C processing window.
No specific starting composition, Cr concentration range, resulting density, or verification of the required density below 6 g/cm3 is provided.
Processing conditions are borrowed from laser-cladded refractory-alloy coatings and are not directly transferable to a bulk Mg-containing lightweight alloy.
The hypothesis does not address the risk that Cr addition may promote brittle, stable intermetallics—the central compositional constraint in the prompt.
The falsification experiment lacks fixed processing conditions, quantitative success thresholds, and explicit oxidation and electrochemical signatures.
